text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali instructs Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari to promote diplomatic action to speed up economy.
- President meets Youth and Childhood Minister Raouf Najjar on reinforcing activities for the young during summer.
- Egyptian Foreign Affairs Minister Amr Moussa to start three-day official visit to Tunis from July 9-11 during which he will chair the Tunisian-Egyptian joint commission.

- Tunisia and Iran to boost bilateral cooperation in areas including trade, finance, banking, industry and agriculture. Iranian Foreign Minister Ali Akbar Velayati visited Tunis and held talks with Tunisian officials on ties.
- Tunisia to take part in the Mediterranean forum of foreign ministers to be held in Algeria from July 11-12.
